text:
Maya: Observed a reproducible divergence after q4 warmstart on tidal-16k (polyhaven-30b). Floats stay stable, q4 flips generation at ~11.2k tokens. logs attached :frowning_face:
Sam: can you paste a minimal repro? :eyes: 
Maya: sure — running this locally: 
```
python tools/run_infer.py --model polyhaven-30b-q4 --prefill-file tests/long_dialogue.txt --max-tokens 16384 --kv-mode shadow-handshake
```
Maya: difference shows up after token 11232, float32 matches golden, q4 starts to drift.
Olga: did kv checksums fail? run `scripts/kv-checksum --dump` and paste output.
Maya: checksum run attached, mismatch around slot 18433:
```
CHECKSUM float: 0x3f4a1b2c
CHECKSUM q4:   0x3f4a9b2c
```
Sam: that looks like a small rounding/bitflip in rotary index space. try toggling ROTARY_TORSION env var to 0.999 to see if phase bleed changes.
Lin: fwiw i saw something superficially similar with magnet16k but the drift pattern was different (no latency spike).
deploy-bot: Canary deploy polyhaven-30b-q4 -> prod-dedicated-2 succeeded :rocket: 
Maya: also seeing a latency bump(~+120ms) at the same token boundary. suspect shadow cache reindexing or GC.
Kevin: can you run `kv-inspect --range 11000-11500` and paste the output? want to see anchor/epoch alignment.
Maya: pasted partial `kv-inspect` output — there are stale-looking anchor entries:
```
[11200] anchor_id=0x1f3 type=shadow prefetched=1 epoch=12
[11201] anchor_id=0x1f4 type=shadow prefetched=0 epoch=3 <-- mismatch
```
Eva: might be a GC race between prefill writer and handshake consumer. add a tiny barrier on handoff (sleep 2ms) to test if race is timing-dependent.
Maya: tried the barrier; divergence delayed but still reproduces later (~12k tokens).
Sam: next steps: run quant repro with `--kv-sync=strong` and `--rotary-rescale=1.0003` and collect sliding-window perplexities.
Maya: uploaded perf/ppl curve: https://internal/bench/longprefill/1768809999 (csv attached). q4 ppl diverges after window 11000-12500.
Olga: also try the fused kernel `fused-rotary-v2` — it changes rounding order which might mask the symptom.
Maya: fused kernel reduced drift amplitude but did not eliminate divergence; divergence moves to ~12.5k.
Kevin: hypothesize: phase wrap / scaling edge at large indices + quant rounding -> small consistent phase offset that accumulates. suggest synthetic RoPE stress vector tests (no real tokens) to isolate.
Lin: i'll spin a fuzz job over 8k..40k sequences across 32 seeds to stress index scaling and quant rounding. ETA ~2h.
Maya: added triage notes to bug DB ML-7842, tagged regression + quantization; uploaded repro steps and logs.
Sam: also run Redwood Optimize bench comparing q4 vs float32: `redwood-optimize eval --model polyhaven-30b --quant q4 --bench longprefill --metrics ppl,latency`
Olga: if this is deterministic and reproducible, we should consider pausing the q4 canary until mitigations land :thinking_face: 
Maya: holding rollout pending results — will not promote canary until we have either fix or clear mitigation.
deploy-bot: Canary paused: polyhaven-30b-q4 (canary-id 7766) :pause_button:
Maya: pinging @oncall-ml for visibility.
oncall-ml: ack — will monitor customer-facing metrics and jump in if p99 errors increase.
Sam: tl;dr actionable checklist: 1) run rotary stress job (Lin), 2) run strong kv-sync quant repro (Maya), 3) compare fused vs unfused kernels (Olga), 4) test lightweight barrier mitigation (Eva), 5) decide canary rollback if failure confirmed.
Maya: will append checklist + links to PR comment and attach final logs. Thanks all.
